CustomField.description: Calculated guidance on what should happen next, based on Stage and readiness counts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Suggested next step for this application. Calculated automatically.
CustomField.label: Next Best Action
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Stage__c), "Draft", "Complete the borrower, product, and request details, then mark intake complete.", "Intake Complete", "Request the required documents from the borrower.", "Documents Pending", IF(Required_Documents_Outstanding__c > 0, "Collect and review outstanding required documents (" & TEXT(Required_Documents_Outstanding__c) & " remaining).", "All required documents are accepted. Assign an underwriter and move to Underwriting."), "Underwriting", IF(ISBLANK(Underwriting_Recommendation__c), "Complete the financial analysis, then record the risk rating and debt service coverage ratio.", Underwriting_Recommendation__c), "Credit Review", "Credit approver to review the request and record a decision.", "Conditionally Approved", IF(Open_Approval_Conditions__c > 0, "Clear the open prior-to-approval conditions (" & TEXT(Open_Approval_Conditions__c) & " remaining).", "Approval conditions are cleared. Move to Approved."), "Approved", "Prepare closing documents and schedule the closing.", "Closing", IF(Open_Closing_Conditions__c > 0, "Clear the open prior-to-closing conditions (" & TEXT(Open_Closing_Conditions__c) & " remaining).", "Closing conditions are cleared. Book the loan."), "Booked", "Loan is booked. Hand off to servicing and monitor post-closing conditions.", "Declined", "Send the decision notice to the borrower and close out open work items.", "Withdrawn", "No further action. Close out open work items.", "")
